functions.name: create
functions.doc:
NEAR path. The caller (the DAO, via a FunctionCall proposal) becomes the
 instance's `dao`. Attach `instance_storage` + the NEAR budget; the budget
 lands in the instance's `"near"` book. Attach ≥ 150 TGas.

functions.name: ft_on_transfer
functions.doc:
USDC/USDT path: `ft_transfer_call(nutus.near, amount, "setup:<SetupConfig json>")`
 from the DAO. Returns the unused amount, so any failure refunds the DAO.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: on_forwarded
functions.doc:
`ft_transfer_call` returns how much the receiver used; hand the rest
 back to the original `ft_transfer_call` so it refunds the DAO.

functions.name: on_instance_created
functions.doc:
After the create batch. NEAR path: refund everything on failure.
 Token path: on success forward the tokens to the instance and return
 whatever it didn't take; on failure return the full amount.

LaneConfig.description: Lane as the DAO submits it. Optional fields take the defaults above.

medium_max.description: Medium: small_max < amount ≤ medium_max. Above → full DAO vote.

objectors.description: `None` = the whole council may object / approve.

period_cap.description: Total Small + Medium payouts allowed per period.

record_steps.description: Track-record ladder for this lane. Empty = no record limit.

silent_can_object.description: Whether council seats flagged silent may still object. Default true.

small_max.description: Small: amount ≤ small_max (and ≤ the recipient's record step).

RecordStep.description: One rung of the track-record ladder: once a recipient has at least `min_paid_jobs` paid jobs, Small payouts up to `small_max` are allowed.

SetupConfig.description: Passed to the instance's `new` (by the factory) during setup.

council.description: Initial council. `None` = read from the DAO policy on first `sync_council`.
